title: Colts chart course of 2026 offseason training program

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Colts chart course of 2026 offseason training program
sources.description: By design, the program emphasizes gradual progression. No live contact is permitted at any stage, but Phase Three allows for non-contact team drills, which is a critical window for installing schemes and evaluating roster battles ahead of training camp.
